name: onenote-local
description: Control local Microsoft OneNote through a Windows desktop MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Read and update local OneNote notebooks.
interface.longDescription: A local Windows MCP bridge for Microsoft OneNote desktop. It can list notebooks, sections, and pages, open a page in OneNote, read page text, create plain pages, create and fill Kanban card pages without a separate body block, append text, and update supported fields and sections on Kanban cards through OneNote COM automation.
defaultPrompt: Find OneNote pages matching a title.
Append this note to a OneNote page.
Create a CrossDetect Kanban task page without a duplicate body block.
Update the assignee and due date on this OneNote Kanban card.
Append these items to the completion section of this OneNote Kanban card.
